title: Five Resources, Five Shapes
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: Five radar charts, one for each resource in the Chapter 3 total score example, showing that equal totals can hide very different shapes.

educational.topic: The shape of ten metric scores behind one total
learningObjectives: The learner will distinguish resources with the same total score by the shape of their ten metric scores, and name the metric to fix first.
prerequisites: The ten metrics and the 0 to 10 scale from [Chapter 3](../../chapters/03-ten-metric-rubric-scoring/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: Which half of the chart is bigger?
Which spoke dips inside the floor ring?
commonMisconceptions: A total of 75 or more always means Adopt
assessmentOpportunities: Two resources total 65. Can you say how they differ from the total alone?
Which resource has nine metrics of 9 and one of 4, and what is its decision?
What does the dashed ring on each chart mark?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Poster zones
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
